_comment_mergedMining: VargaMesh (VMESH, chain ID 22093 = 0x564D) can only be merge-mined: AuxPoW is mandatory from block 1, so this pool has no ports. Parent pools merge-mine it for their solo miners (auxCoins.vargamesh in bitcoinsilver.json, mode getblocktemplate); this pool's payment processor pays those VMESH solo blocks to the miners' vmesh= addresses. Keep paymentProcessing.enabled and paymentProcessing.soloMining on, and use the same daemon/wallet and pool address as auxCoins.vargamesh.
_comment_ports: No stratum ports: VMESH blocks without AuxPoW are invalid.
_comment_poolId: use it for region identification: eu, us, asia or keep default if you have one stratum instance for one coin
